gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: In 2014, Syndicate 1084 reported a prior year reserve release of GBP 77.4 million, representing 5.81% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by favourable claims development on losses from prior periods, predominantly within the Marine, Property, and Treaty Divisions. The Casualty Division also experienced a consistent flow of prior year reserve releases, particularly from financial institutions and institutional healthcare. The year also saw several catastrophe events, including Hurricane Odile, Super Typhoon Haiyan, heavy snowfall in Japan, and US hailstorms/tornadoes, with net losses from each event reported to be below GBP 10 million. Additionally, the syndicate noted further deterioration on the Costa Concordia loss and significant losses from the Sewol ferry disaster and other charterer liability claims within the Marine division.
